nuggets.text: Kirk Ferentz is the longest-tenured active head coach in college football, with 210 career wins.
Kamari Moulton ran for 183 yards in the opener, the most by a Hawkeye in a season opener since 1997.
The Hawkeyes have won seven straight night games at Kinnick Stadium since 2022.
C.J. Beathard, quarterback of the Hawkeyes' first-ever 12-0 regular season in 2015, is Saturday's honorary captain.
After the first quarter, Hawkeyes fans turn and wave to patients watching from the University of Iowa Children's Hospital.
Kinnick Stadium is the only college football stadium named for a Heisman winner, 1939's Nile Kinnick.
The Hawkeyes' visiting locker room is all pink, down to the urinals, a Hayden Fry idea to put opponents in a passive mood.
Herky the Hawk began as a 1948 drawing by a journalism instructor and was first called Hercules the Hawk.
The 2011 Cy-Hawk Trophy, showing a farm family, was ridiculed within hours and later redesigned with fan input.
Evan James returned a punt 77 yards for a touchdown in the Hawkeyes' 40-0 opening win over Northern Illinois.
